Former US Senator Jon Kyl Dies at 84

Jon Kyl, a former Republican Senator from Arizona, has died at the age of 84. Kyl, who served multiple terms in the U.S. Senate, was known for his behind-the-scenes legislative work and his role as a "workhorse" in shaping policy, particularly water policy. He also held the position of GOP whip. His death was reported by multiple news outlets.
